explanation: Fires throughout passages that describe natural physical geography: where land, water and landforms lie (coasts, lakes, islands, reefs, mountains, valleys, deserts, forests, habitats). It peaks above half of max on terrain adjectives (shallow, rugged, rocky, sandy, coastal, tropical, steep) and on locative words just before a landform (tip of, foothills of, along the, overlooking the, off, between two). Texts with no landscape are predicted inactive: business, medicine, code, city streets and buildings, kitchenware, gardens. A lone compass or terrain word used non-geographically, such as 'rugged man', 'northern side of the office', 'eastern European economy' or 'northern tip of the screen', gives only weak to moderate activity (about 0.25-0.5 of max).
